requirements.entry_requirements: STPM Grade C in two subjects AND pass in Math and English; OR STAM Jayyid AND pass in Math and English; OR Diploma/Advanced Diploma; OR Matriculation/Foundation CGPA 2.00; OR UEC Grade B in five subjects AND pass in Math and English. 2 years work experience required
